title: Helix standard version record v1
description: One pinned GA4GH specification version Helix may eventually test against. Design-only until standards/registry.yaml exists. Authoritative source is GA4GH, not Ferrum, not HelixTest README URLs, not Git HEAD. support_status is available|supported only; tested and verified are run/claim states, not this document. Not HELIOS: no signature, ro_crate, audit_trail, evidence, or PDF. Not GA4GH certification. Spec: docs/STANDARDS_REGISTRY.md.

schema_version.description: Frozen document id for a single version record. Must match this schema file.

pack_id.description: Stable Helix pack id. Official line: ga4gh.{standard}.{version} (e.g. ga4gh.drs.1.4.0). Disambiguate if the same numeric version exists in another release_class (e.g. ga4gh.drs.1.5.0-ballot). Do not recycle.

standard.description: Machine id aligned with Helix discovery/service (drs, wes, tes, trs, htsget, beacon). Not a target implementation.

product.description: Official GA4GH product title (e.g. Data Repository Service). Not Ferrum, not Helix, not HelixTest.

version.description: Version string as published by GA4GH for this release. Not inferred from /ga4gh/*/v1. Not the Helix crate version.

release_class.description: How GA4GH published this artifact. Default automated verification uses official only. Ballot and snapshot are never in all-supported-versions. Development cannot be supported.

support_status.description: Helix pack lifecycle. available = pinned (steps 1–3). supported = mapped, implemented, fixture-proven (steps 1–7). A git tag alone is not supported. tested and verified must not appear here.

repository.description: Canonical HTTPS URL of the specification git repository, no .git suffix. GA4GH org or the spec home GA4GH publishes (e.g. samtools/hts-specs for htsget). Not SynapticFour/Helix, HelixTest, or Ferrum.

release_ref.description: Published git tag or GitHub Release name for this version. For official, ballot, and snapshot must not be HEAD, main, master, or develop.

commit.description: Exact git commit of repository at the pin. Never a moving branch tip. Helix must not silently replace this with HEAD.

retrieved_at.description: UTC calendar date the normative bytes were retrieved. Update on every pin refresh.

normative_sources.description: Specification files at commit that Helix treats as normative for this pack. Each file is hashed. Runtime must not fetch replacements.

test_bindings.description: Required and non-empty when support_status is supported. Maps Helix check ids to this pack. kind normative requires a locator inside a pinned file.

fixture_catalog.description: Helix fixture catalog id used to prove this pack (e.g. helix-fixtures-v1). Required when support_status is supported. Not a GA4GH version. Not HELIOS.

notes.description: Human caveats. Not a substitute for bindings or hashes.

schema_entry.description: Path inside the vendored pack of the schema document the checker compiles (e.g. openapi/components/schemas/DrsObject.yaml). Not a GitHub Pages bundle.

schema_component.description: OpenAPI/JSON Schema component name compiled from schema_entry (e.g. DrsObject).

catalog_id.description: sha256 of the compiled support catalog + coverage levels. Must match the executable contract. YAML cannot invent this.

binding_id.description: sha256 of catalog_id + pack + schema hashes + checker_id. A catalog change must not keep the old binding_id.

releaseClass.description: OFFICIAL | BALLOT | SNAPSHOT | DEVELOPMENT. Default automation: official only. all-supported-versions: supported official only. Ballot/snapshot: explicit selection only. Development: never supported.

supportStatus.description: AVAILABLE = pinned metadata. SUPPORTED = steps 1–7 complete. Do not encode TESTED or VERIFIED here.

integrity.description: Hash of the exact file bytes Helix loads. SHA-256 only in v1. Not a HELIOS signature.

packIntegrity.description: sha256-manifest-v1 of every vendored file in this pack. Not a single-file hash. Not HELIOS.

normativeSource.description: One specification file at the pinned commit.

path.description: Path inside the GA4GH repository at commit (e.g. openapi/openapi.yaml).

source_url.description: Exact URL from which these bytes were retrieved. Must not be an unpinned site root.

role.description: What kind of normative artifact this file is.

retrieved_at.description: Per-file retrieval date if it differs from the pack retrieved_at.

vendor_path.description: Path in this Helix repo of the committed copy (e.g. standards/vendor/ga4gh.drs.1.4.0/openapi.yaml). Bytes must match integrity.hex. Required when support_status is supported. Optional on available pins that are not yet loaded at runtime.

testBinding.description: One Helix check in this pack. Changing id/code is a Helix compatibility change, not a registry-only edit.

kind.description: Claim taxonomy. normative = locator exists in a pinned source Helix loads. guidance = official GA4GH implementation guidance (not HelixTest policy). fixture / interoperability / security / benchmark are Helix or HelixTest behaviour. Only normative may back a Verified-against-{standard}-{version} sentence. Do not label fixture extras as normative.

citation.description: Required when kind is normative. Must be traceable in the pinned file. If it cannot be established, kind must not be normative.
Machine-readable pointer into a pinned normative file. Do not invent MUSTs from memory.

source_path.description: Must match a normative_sources[].path in this record.

locator.description: Value of that locator type (e.g. GetObject, DrsObject, /components/schemas/DrsObject).

excerpt.description: Optional short excerpt copied from the pinned file, not from memory.

packCoverage.description: Declared coverage of the supported pack. Not a score or percentage. complete|partial|none only.

notes.description: Covered / partially covered / not covered in prose. Not a compliance percentage.

registryDocument.description: Proposed shape of standards/registry.yaml after YAML-to-JSON. Not a second on-disk schema file. This file’s root is still a single version record.
